Residents:
Yuki (50s) works from home. Weekdays: at desk (bedroom_1) 9:00-17:30. Often out for lunch. Hobbies: gym, running, friends.
Nora (40s) works in town. Weekdays: out 8:00-17:30. Home evenings. Hobbies: napping, reading, sketching. Cares for dog.
Weekends: Both sleep in, errands midday, home rest of day.

Object Locations & Movements:
Static Items (Walkthrough Tue 18:00):
- Balcony: Watering can on floor.
- Bathroom: Nora’s skincare/toiletry bag on shelf; razor on sink; towels on rack.
- Bedroom 1 (Yuki): Desk has laptop, charger, pen. Nightstand has book, tablet. Wardrobe had gym bag.
- Bedroom 2 (Nora): Desk has pencil case, sketchbook. Nightstand has book.
- Entry: Doormat, vacuum on floor. Dog leash, hat, jacket, scarf, shoes on hook. Keys, wallet on table. Running shoes on rack.
- Kitchen: Dishes in cupboard/sink. Dog bowl on floor. Dog food in pantry.
- Living: Standard furniture items.

Dynamic Items (Observed Wed):
- Yuki’s Items:
  - Laptop: Stays on desk_b1 all day.
  - Tablet: Nightstand_b1 (night) -> desk_b1 (day) -> Nightstand_b1 (night).

  - Mug: Cupboard_k1 (night) -> desk_b1 (day) -> sink_k1 (evening) -> desk_b1 (night).
  - Gym Bag: Entry_floor_e1 (night) -> desk_b1 (evening). Likely taken to gym in evening.
  - Hat: Shoe_rack_e1 (night) -> dresser_b1 (evening).
  - Shoes: Entry_floor_e1 (night) -> shoe_rack_e1 (evening).
  - Wallet: Entry_floor_e1 (night) -> entry_table_e1 (evening).

  - Jacket/Scarf/Umbrella: Entry_hook_e1 (night) -> gone (day, likely on person or taken out) -> Entry_hook_e1 (evening).

- Nora’s Items:
  - Laptop: Entry_floor_e1 (night) -> not in any room (day, taken to work) -> nightstand_b2 (evening).
  - Phone: Nightstand_b2 (night) -> not in any room (day, on person) -> bed_b2 (evening).
  - Water Bottle: Dish_rack_k1 (night) -> not in any room (day, taken to work) -> dish_rack_k1 (evening) -> sink_k1 (late night).

- Shared Items:

  - Dog Food Bag: Pantry_shelf_k1 (night) -> floor_k_k1 (evening) -> Pantry_shelf_k1 (late night).
